description: Two or three consecutive mode-omitted case commands, initially at offset 2 inside hello. CN1 expands the target to a selection and cycles; pinned Wordcraft moves the caret to the word end after the first change and subsequent commands leave HELLO unchanged. Full-selection cycling is compared separately. This is a specific implementation behavior, not a Java versus Rust conclusion.
